0022600162.text: The Wizards, in their seventh game of the season, are 3-3 overall and 1-2 on the road, sitting 6th in the East, while the Magic are 2-3 and 0-2 at home, 9th in the East and 0.5 games behind the Wizards' division-leading pace in the Southeast. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (out, foot) and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip, pinched nerve), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 136-131 loss in Orlando on March 12, 2026.
